environment.libero: LIBERO-PRO fork, commit 5368540790fde9a18584d64105ec5ac16d8926bd (origin uynitsuj/LIBERO-PRO), libero 0.1.0, robosuite 1.4.0, mujoco 3.5.0
environment.official_done: bddl_base_domain.py BDDLBaseDomain.step(): done = self._check_success() on EVERY control step; no hold, no release, no settling requirement
environment.official_In: In(book, region) = check_contact AND check_contain; for a SITE target check_contact returns True always (base_object_states.py), check_contain = SiteObject.in_box on the book BODY ORIGIN (world frame, lb_z -= 0.01); i.e. In is a pure origin-in-box test
environment.gap_to_replay: demos came from the official LIBERO dataset and replay-succeeded in this env (Step 14); not re-verified against upstream LIBERO master source

metrics_and_judgement_points.M1_official_task_success: first control step k at which the official In is true (geometric rule verified equal to env In on 500/500 states, frame_check.json). Under the official protocol the episode ends at k. Recorded trajectories are NOT truncated; k and the stage at k are reported.
metrics_and_judgement_points.M2_instruction_completion: ordinary T5 request = 'pick the book and place it in the back compartment of the caddy': all executor stages complete (approach, descend, grasp, lift, transport, place WITHOUT timeout, release command + fingers open, retreat), status 'completed', no guard abort / place_failure. A manner request that names a stage (e.g. 'lower slowly and release') is judged over THAT stage to its end, which includes the release; the evaluation may not end at M1's step k.
metrics_and_judgement_points.M3_post_release_observation: reported separately, NOT part of the ordinary gate: official In on the final state, book detached from the hand, book settled inside the compartment footprint (xy), tilt, last-10-step displacement, z margin to the In lower bound. 'settled in the compartment' and 'official In true' are different facts and are never merged.
metrics_and_judgement_points.M4_contact_audit: frozen contact_policy_v1.1 (DetailRecorder + evaluate; windows from the executor record, unchanged), v0 shown alongside. clean_v1 required. Not relaxed for T5.

ordinary_gate_per_init: M1 reached AND M2 complete AND M4 clean_v1; M3 reported, not gated
forbidden: truncating an existing run to its M1 frame and calling it qualified data
changing In, GUARD, GripPlan, contact policy or place_tol_m after seeing the held-out result
new execution capability (leaning placement) before this gate is judged
on_heldout_failure: classify by stage from failure records (pose tracking / in-hand holding / missing execution capability); no parameter expansion
